hero.title: BBS in Mauritius for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Earn a comprehensive Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) in Mauritius, integrating core management principles, business economics, quantitative analysis, and corporate strategy. International students build strong business acumen in a politically stable, regional financial hub connecting African and Asian commercial markets.

overview: A Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) is an undergraduate degree that covers business principles, management, accounting, finance, marketing, economics and organizational operations. It can be suitable for students wishing to prepare themselves for careers in business, administration, financial services, entrepreneurship or for further education in management. BBS in Mauritius is a study option for students interested in undergraduate business education and developing a foundation in business-related subjects.
Explore top internationally affiliated universities and leading higher education campuses in Mauritius offering British, French, and Australian degree qualifications.

universities.name: University of Mauritius (UoM)
universities.desc: UoM is the premier public research university of Mauritius, offering internationally recognized undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in science, engineering, and agriculture.

universities.name: Université des Mascareignes (UdM)
universities.desc: Partnered with Université de Limoges (France), UdM delivers dual European-Mauritian accredited diplomas with bilingual instruction and industry internships.

universities.name: Middlesex University Mauritius
universities.desc: A branch campus of Middlesex University London, delivering British honors degrees with global validation, modern coastal campus, and international faculty.

universities.name: Curtin Mauritius
universities.desc: An international campus of Curtin University Australia, providing accredited Australian business, IT, and humanities degrees in state-of-the-art facilities.
